name: ElinorCare Plus
description:
Description:
ElinorCare Plus is a balanced multivitamin and mineral supplement formulated to support overall health, immunity, and energy levels. It helps in maintaining nutritional balance and supports daily wellness.

Indications:

Nutritional deficiencies

General weakness and fatigue

Immune system support

Dosage:
As directed by the physician.

name: ElinoPain Relief
description:
Description:
ElinoPain Relief is used to reduce pain and inflammation. It provides effective relief from mild to moderate pain and improves mobility.

Indications:

Muscle pain

Joint pain

Headache and body ache

Dosage:
As prescribed by the healthcare professional.

name: ElinorCough Syrup
description:
Description:
ElinorCough Syrup helps relieve cough, throat irritation, and chest congestion. It provides soothing relief and improves breathing comfort.

Indications:

Dry cough

Productive cough

Throat irritation

Dosage:
As directed by the physician.
